assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide editorial transition banner photograph for an About Us page
Primary request: A photorealistic close view of a modern multi-head embroidery machine actively stitching on navy and cream fabric.
Scene/backdrop: A light, neutral, tidy textile workshop with softly receding rows of machine heads creating architectural repetition; the setting remains generic and unbranded.
Subject: One main embroidery head and needle area clearly centered over a hoop of deep navy fabric with fine cream stitching in progress; subtle pale fabric can appear beside it. Show believable thread tension, needle and machine hardware.
Style/medium: Premium industrial editorial photography with realistic machine detail and textile fibers, natural and restrained.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape banner framing, low side angle close to work surface, main machine centered and dominant, repeated machine forms leading across the background. Keep the central machine and active stitching within a safe horizontal crop for a shallow 280px-high display banner. Native wide HD output, 1536 pixels or more across.
Lighting/mood: Soft window daylight, balanced light neutral workshop, crisp focus on the main needle head, background gently softened.
Color palette: Light warm gray and ivory workshop surfaces, deep navy cloth, cream thread, quiet metal details.
Materials/textures: Brushed metal, matte painted machine housing, dense woven cloth, visible thread and clean embroidery stitches.
Constraints: No people, labels, serial numbers, brand names, logos, stars, readable text, watermark, or identifiable company marks.
assets.note: Synthetic editorial service imagery. These are illustrative representations of service activities, not documentary photographs of actual staff, suppliers, facilities, or a factory.
